tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- This recorded session navigates to the Magento Admin Shipments grid, closed a popup, entered four filters (Shipment #, Order #, Ship-to, Total Qty), applied Search, performed Export (CSV), used Select Visible, chose a mass action (PDF Packingslips), applied it, and opened the View page for the resulting shipment. Stable elementHashes were recorded for each interactive control.

Task Definition:
- Build a reusable, parameterized tool that replicates the above sequence: navigate to the shipments grid URL, set filter values supplied by the caller, apply the filters, optionally export the grid, select visible rows, perform a mass-action, and open the 'View' page for the first result. The tool should use the deterministic elementHash selectors captured during the demo for reliability.

Action Plan:
1. Navigate to the provided admin_url.
2. Close any 'Incoming Message' popup that blocks controls (recorded close link hash).
3. Input filters: shipment_increment_id, order_increment_id, ship_to_name, total_qty_from, total_qty_to using recorded input elementHashes.
4. Click Search and wait for the grid to refresh.
5. Select Export format and click Export (recorded select/button hashes).
6. Click 'Select Visible' to select the filtered row(s).
7. Choose the mass-action option by visible text and click Submit (recorded select/button hashes).
8. Click the View link for the first filtered row using the recorded view link elementHash.
9. Extract the filtered rows and first row View href for return to the caller.

Variable Identification:
- admin_url (required) — deterministic navigation target.
- shipment_increment_id, order_increment_id, ship_to_name, total_qty_from, total_qty_to — user-supplied filters used to narrow results.
- export_format (CSV/Excel/XML) — export option visible text.
- massaction_option_text — exact visible text of the massaction option (e.g. 'PDF Packingslips').
- open_view_after_actions (bool) — whether to open the View link; documented but the recorded tool will perform the click using the recorded selector.

Step Optimization and Selector Choices:
- Where possible the tool uses recorded elementHash values to locate and interact with elements deterministically (these elementHashes were captured from actual interactions during the demo). This avoids ambiguous selectors that can match multiple elements in Magento admin grids.
- Navigation is done directly to the admin shipments URL rather than navigating through menus.
- Popup closure is performed immediately to ensure underlying controls are clickable.
- The tool does not attempt to re-compute XPath or text-based selectors at runtime; instead it relies on the recorded elementHashes which map to unique elements in the demo environment.
- Caveat: elementHashes are environment-specific; if the target admin theme / DOM differs greatly the hash may not resolve. If that occurs, replace a step's elementHash with an XPath from the recorded fallback selectors (documented in the session logs) or run a DOM discovery step to re-locate elements.

Notes on Optional Actions:
- The tool includes steps for Export, Select Visible, Mass Action and View — these are parameter-driven. The input schema marks their parameters as optional so callers who do not want certain actions can pass empty values (or an empty string). The steps themselves are deterministic and will run in order using the provided parameters.

Authentication:
- The recorded demo performed a login earlier, but per tool guidelines the automation assumes the session is already authenticated when navigating to admin_url. Do not include login steps here.

Stability Recommendations:
- Run this tool against a staging environment first.
- If any click/select fails, re-capture the element's selector in the target environment and replace the corresponding elementHash entry with a validated XPath or CSS selector.

This tool provides a single-sequence deterministic automation that replicates the demo run and exposes the key inputs needed to filter shipments and perform the post-filter actions used in the demo.
name: magento_admin_shipments_filter_and_actions
description: Navigate to the Magento Admin Shipments grid, apply filters (Shipment #, Order #, Ship-to, Total Qty), perform Export, Select Visible, Mass Action (e.g., PDF Packingslips), and open a shipment View — using deterministic selectors recorded during the demo. This tool assumes the session is already authenticated when the provided admin_url is reachable.

steps.description: Navigate to the provided Magento admin shipments grid URL.
Close the 'Incoming Message' popup if present using the recorded close link selector.
Enter Shipment # into the Shipment # filter input (recorded elementHash).
Enter Order # into the Order # filter input (recorded elementHash).
Enter Ship to Name into the Ship-to filter input (recorded elementHash).
Enter Total Qty 'From' value (recorded elementHash for the From input).
Enter Total Qty 'To' value (recorded elementHash for the To input).
Click the Search / Apply Filters button to refresh the grid with the filter values.
Wait for the grid to refresh after applying filters.
Select the requested export format from the Export dropdown (CSV / Excel / XML). Uses the recorded export select elementHash.
Click the Export button to trigger the export for the selected format (recorded elementHash).
Wait for the export to start/finish (download or server response).
Click 'Select Visible' to select all visible rows in the filtered grid (recorded elementHash).
Choose the mass-action option from the Actions select (example: 'PDF Packingslips'). Uses recorded massaction select elementHash.
Click the mass-action Submit/Apply button to trigger the chosen action (recorded elementHash).
Wait for the mass-action to execute (form submission or server processing).
Click the row 'View' link to open the shipment detail page for the first filtered row (recorded elementHash).
Return structured data about the filtered results and the View page href for the first result.
steps.goal: Extract filtered grid rows (shipment numbers, order numbers, ship-to names, total qty) and the View link href for the first row

input_schema.name: admin_url
input_schema.description: Full URL to the Magento Admin Shipments grid (example: "http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/sales_shipment/"). The tool will navigate here as the first step.

input_schema.name: shipment_increment_id
input_schema.description: Shipment number to filter by (e.g. "100000032"). Leave empty to skip setting this filter (note: this tool will still attempt to interact with the recorded selector).

input_schema.name: export_format
input_schema.description: Export format to select in the Export dropdown. Provide exact visible option text (CSV / Excel / XML). Leave empty to skip export (tool will still attempt the action).

input_schema.name: massaction_option_text
input_schema.description: Visible text of the mass-action option to choose (for example: "PDF Packingslips" or "Print Shipping Labels"). Use the exact visible option text present in the admin UI.

input_schema.name: open_view_after_actions
input_schema.description: If true, click the View link for the (first) filtered shipment row after other actions. If omitted or false the tool will still attempt the click (recorded selector will be used).
